name: Cheek 2 Cheek
source:
A game about managing and defining relationships, identities, and self actualization in an age of shifting boundaries. Explore non-traditional relationships in a non-violent play space.

[From [url=http://adamrickert.itch.io/cheek-2-cheek]itch.io[/url]]

"It's about butts."

[From [url=https://twitter.com/johnnemann/status/554438858633265152]Twitter[/url]]

Created for [url=http://itch.io/jam/gxdev]GXDev[/url].
translation:
一款关于管理与定义关系、身份及自我实现的游戏，发生在边界不断变化的时代。在非暴力游玩空间中探索非传统关系。

“这就是关于屁股的游戏。”

为[url=http://itch.io/jam/gxdev]GXDev[/url]制作。

[译自[url=http://adamrickert.itch.io/cheek-2-cheek]itch.io[/url]]
